value: 35 Swedish health care students (medical, nursing, dentistry)
Travel destinations: Indian peninsula (18 students) and Central Africa (17 students)
Specimens collected median 4 days before departure and 22 days after return
None took antibiotics within 6 months prior to sampling
Sequencing technology: Illumina HiSeq 2000 for metagenomic; Illumina MiSeq for isolates
ESBL screening done with chromogenic culture media
Resistance genes analyzed from >300 total genes detected
